hypothesis: Symmetric Q4_0 has the same 18-byte-per-32-weight payload as Q4_K but a simpler block decode and dot-product path on AVX2. Replacing the same 288 Q8_0 tensors with Q4_0 may convert the Q4_K candidate's 18.6% target-only gain into at least 20% while clearing the 8% MTP3 gate. Because Q4_0 has weaker scale geometry, this remains a PTQ fast-path ceiling screen and must beat the Q4_K result before any training is justified.
stop_rules: Reject invalid or collapsed artifacts before timing.
Reject before paired serving if graph speed is below 1.10x control or below 1.03x the prior Q4_K candidate.
Reject before MMLU and MATH if target, MTP3, CUTE, or WikiText gates fail.
Do not retain both full-model derived candidates on the 225 GB node.
recovery_boundary: If Q4_0 is faster but fails quality, do not promote it. Use its measured ceiling to justify trained per-channel scales, QAT, or a sensitivity-selected Q4_0/Q4_K/Q5/Q8 mixture plus MTP-draft alignment.
claim_boundary: A pass would identify a CPU fast-path format for the formerly Q8 matrices. It would not establish a trained approximation, final-node throughput, energy gains, 100 accepted tok/s, novelty, or a breakthrough.
